name: Angle clip 100 x 100 x 10
function: Joins the header to the purlin. 2 bolts into each.

name: Drop column weldment
function: Hangs from the header and carries the J1 base. Hot-dip galvanised.

name: Header beam, RHS 200 x 180 x 8
function: Spans the 2 canopy purlins over the arm. It carries the column.

name: Canopy purlin (part of the canopy)
function: Carries the solar roof. Shown for context.

name: Hex head screw M12 x 40
function: Bolts the clip to the header web.

name: Hex head screw M16 x 70
function: Bolts the column top plate to the header.

name: Prevailing-torque hex nut (nylon insert) M12
function: Holds the bolt's clamp force on the far side of the joint. The nylon ring grips the thread, so vibration cannot turn the nut loose.

name: Prevailing-torque hex nut (nylon insert) M16
function: Holds the bolt's clamp force on the far side of the joint. The nylon ring grips the thread, so vibration cannot turn the nut loose.

name: Plain washer 12
function: Puts the clamp force of the head or the nut on a larger area, so the part surface does not crush and the preload stays constant.

name: Plain washer 16
function: Puts the clamp force of the head or the nut on a larger area, so the part surface does not crush and the preload stays constant.

name: J1 base casting
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Holds the J1 bearing under the column and shrouds the ring gear. Its flange bolts to the column foot.

name: Accent band, J1 base
function: OTTOYARD red band at the root of the moving machine.

name: J1 hub
function: Joins link 1 to the bearing inner ring and carries the ring gear. The union's rotor passes inside it.

name: J1 pinion and shaft, module 2, 14 teeth
function: Drives the J1 ring gear from the gearmotor above.

name: J1 ring gear, module 2, 130 teeth (drawn at its pitch circle)
function: Turns link 1. The pinion on the gearmotor drives it.

name: J1 servo gearmotor, 750 W, 25:1 planetary, brake
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Turns J1 through the pinion. Its brake holds the arm's heading with power off.

name: Cross-roller bearing 100 x 160 x 16
function: Carries link 1 under the base casting. It takes the arm's weight and moment.

name: Socket head cap screw M12 x 40
function: Holds the base casting to the column foot.

name: Socket head cap screw M8 x 20
function: Holds the J1 hub to link 1.

name: Link 1 weldment
function: Carries J2 at 0.95 m from J1. A box section: stiff in bending and twist. The duct and cables run inside.

name: Link 1 top cover
function: Closes the link. Off for service.

name: Button head screw M5 x 10
function: Holds the link cover.

name: J2 drum cover, upper
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Closes the J2 bearing and gears between the links.

name: J2 hub
function: Joins link 2 to the bearing inner ring and carries the ring gear. The union's rotor passes inside it.

name: J2 drum cover, lower
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Turns with link 2 under the upper cover. A labyrinth between them sheds water.

name: J2 pinion and shaft, module 2, 14 teeth
function: Drives the J2 ring gear from the gearmotor in link 1.

name: J2 ring gear, module 2, 94 teeth (drawn at its pitch circle)
function: Turns link 2. The pinion on the gearmotor in link 1 drives it.

name: J2 servo gearmotor, 400 W, right-angle, brake
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Turns J2 through the pinion from inside link 1. Its brake holds the fold.

name: Cross-roller bearing 100 x 150 x 13
function: Carries link 2 under link 1.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 16
function: Holds the J2 hub to link 2.

name: Link 2 weldment
function: Carries the mast 0.80 m from J2. The duct and cables run inside.

name: Link 2 top cover
function: Closes link 2. Off for service. The duct leaves through it to the J3 union.

name: Mast carriage lid
function: Closes the carriage and clamps the bearing outer ring.

name: Mast carriage housing
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Carries the J3 bearing, its drive and the swivel at the tip of link 2. The mast hangs through its floor.

name: Mast top collar
function: Grips the mast top in its socket and carries the driven ring and the bearing inner ring.

name: Timing belt HTD 5M, 25 mm, 654 mm
function: Turns the mast from the servo gearmotor, 5:1.

name: Servo gearmotor, 400 W, 20:1 planetary
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
subsystems: J3 mast yaw x1; Telescoping mast x1
function: Drives J3 through the belt. Its brake holds the mast angle when power is off.

name: Timing pulley HTD 5M 120T, 25 mm belt
function: Drives the toothed belt with no slip.

name: Timing pulley HTD 5M 24T, 25 mm belt
function: Drives the toothed belt with no slip.

name: Cross-roller bearing 170 x 250 x 24
function: Carries the mast and lets it turn. It takes the mast moment in one bearing.

name: Rotary union with slip ring, J3: DN 50 vacuum, air, 12 circuits
function: Passes the vacuum and the signals across J3, which turns 462 degrees in a cycle. Its rotor turns with the mast; the mast is the vacuum duct down to the wrist.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 25
function: Clamps the slewing bearing outer ring under the lid.

name: Button head screw M5 x 12
function: Holds the carriage lid.

name: Mast stage 1 (outer), 160 x 160 x 4
function: Turns with J3 and guides the middle stage.

name: Mast stage 2 (middle), 125 x 125 x 3.5
function: Carries the rack and the doubling pulley.

name: Mast stage 3 (inner), 95 x 95 x 3
function: Carries the wrist at its foot.

name: Doubling belt, inner run, 25 x 2
function: Anchored to stage 1 and stage 3 over the sheave on stage 2: stage 3 moves twice as far.

name: Doubling belt, outer run, 25 x 2
function: Anchored to stage 1 and stage 3 over the sheave on stage 2: stage 3 moves twice as far.

name: Doubling sheave, 14 mm, acetal
function: Turns the doubling belt over the middle stage's top.

name: Wear pad, acetal, 13.5 x 30 x 50
function: Guides one stage inside the next with low friction and no play.

name: Wear pad, acetal, 11.5 x 30 x 50
function: Guides one stage inside the next with low friction and no play.

name: Pinion module 2, 14 teeth
function: Drives the rack.

name: Gear rack module 2, 20 x 20
function: The pinion drives the middle stage along it.

name: Socket head cap screw M5 x 16
function: Holds the rack to the middle stage, from inside it.

name: Wrist fork
function: Hangs from the inner stage foot. Its cheeks carry the J4 gear unit and motor on one side and the stub bearing and the swivel on the other; the vacuum passes through it into the mast.

name: Wrist hub
function: Turns on J4 and carries the wand. The air leaves through its hollow stub.

name: Timing belt HTD 3M, 9 mm, 265 mm
function: Drives the J4 gear unit from its motor, 2:1.

name: J4 gear unit output flange
function: The gear unit's turning flange: it carries the hub.

name: J4 strain-wave gear unit, size 17, 100:1, with output bearing
function: Turns the hub 100 times slower than its input pulley. Its cross-roller bearing carries the wand.

name: J4 servo motor 200 W, 40 mm frame, brake and encoder
function: Drives the J4 gear unit by the belt. Its brake holds the wand with power off.

name: Timing pulley HTD 3M 20T, 9 mm belt
function: Drives the toothed belt with no slip.

name: Timing pulley HTD 3M 40T, 9 mm belt
function: Drives the toothed belt with no slip.

name: Deep groove ball bearing 61910-2RS
function: Supports the hub's hollow stub in the fork's +Z cheek.

name: Clock spring lead connector, M8, right angle
function: Joins the cassette's lead to the fixed cable.

name: Wrist clock-spring cassette, flat cable, 8 circuits + EtherCAT pair
function: Carries the wand's power and network across J4. Its flat cable winds and unwinds as the wrist turns.

name: Wrist fixed cable, cassette to the coil clamp
function: Joins the clock spring to the coil cable. It does not move.

name: Wrist fixed air line, union to the coil clamp
function: Joins the union's air passage to the coil's air line. It does not move.

name: Retaining ring, shaft 50
function: Holds the bearing in its seat.

name: Socket head cap screw M4 x 12
function: Holds the hub to the J4 gear unit's output flange.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 45
function: Holds the wrist fork to the inner stage foot.

name: Wand tube 1 (base), 68 x 2.5
function: Carries the vacuum flow and guides tube 2. Bonded into the hub.

name: Wand tube 2, 58.6 x 1.5
function: Slides in tube 1 on a lip seal and carries a pulley for the next tube's cable.

name: Wand tube 3, 51.3 x 1.5
function: Slides in tube 2 on a lip seal and carries a pulley for the next tube's cable.

name: Wand tube 4, 44 x 2
function: Slides in tube 3 and carries the nozzle.

name: Wand linear drive, ball screw, stroke 307
function: Pushes tube 2 out and pulls it back. Cables take tubes 3 and 4 with it.

name: Wand cable with air line, on a reel in the drive
function: Feeds the nozzle drive, the light ring and the air knife along the wand. The reel takes up what the wand does not need.

name: Radial shaft seal 44 x 48.3 x 6
function: Seals tube 4 in tube 3, so the vacuum does not leak there.

name: Radial shaft seal 51.3 x 55.6 x 6
function: Seals tube 3 in tube 2, so the vacuum does not leak there.

name: Radial shaft seal 58.6 x 63 x 6
function: Seals tube 2 in tube 1, so the vacuum does not leak there.

name: Nozzle knuckle housing
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Carries the nozzle pivot and its worm drive on the wand tip.

name: Nozzle gearmotor, 36 mm, with worm stage
function: Pitches the head. The worm locks it, so it holds its angle with power off.

name: Push-in fitting, 6 mm tube, M5
function: Holds the air line's end and seals it.

name: Air line 6 mm, nozzle loop
function: Brings the air across the nozzle joint to the air knife.

name: Air knife, slot 0.05 mm
function: Blows a thin sheet of air into seams. The dust goes into the vacuum flow.

name: Brush lip, nylon 0.2 mm
function: Lifts dust and crumbs from the fabric into the flow.

name: Nozzle head, vacuum duct
function: Spreads the vacuum across a 150 mm mouth.

name: Socket head cap screw M3 x 10
function: Holds the air knife to the head.

name: Line clamp bracket on the fork
function: Holds the reel line's lower end on the wrist fork.

name: Mast reel bracket, aluminium
function: Holds the reel on the outer mast stage.

name: Hybrid cable and air line on the mast reel, PUR
function: Feeds the wrist, the wand and the nozzle down the mast. The reel pays it out as the mast goes down.

name: Spring reel for a hybrid cable and an air line, 3 m
function: Pays out and takes back the wrist's cable and air line as the mast goes down and up.

name: Hybrid cable and air line, J3 union to the mast reel
function: Brings the signals, power and air from the J3 union down the outer mast stage to the reel.

name: Vacuum duct in link 1, 54 x 2
function: Carries the vacuum along link 1 from J1 to J2.

name: Vacuum duct in link 2, 54 x 2
function: Carries the vacuum along link 2 from J2 and up into the J3 union.

name: Rotary union with slip ring, J1: DN 50 vacuum, air, 24 circuits
function: Passes the vacuum, the air and the signals across J1. Its body stands in the column; its rotor turns with link 1.

name: Rotary union with slip ring, J2: DN 50 vacuum, air, 24 circuits
function: Passes the vacuum, the air and the signals across J2. Its body sits in link 1's tip; its rotor turns with link 2.

name: Vacuum riser pipe, 50 mm
function: Brings the vacuum from the canopy duct down the column to the J1 union.

name: Wrist vacuum duct, 36 x 3
function: Joins the swivel to the fork's passage up into the mast. Bonded at both ends.

name: Wrist rotary union: 50 mm vacuum, 1 air passage
function: Lets the hub's stub turn while the vacuum flows through it to the duct. The air crosses in a groove between 2 lip seals and a channel drilled along the stub's wall.

name: Socket head cap screw M5 x 30
function: Holds the wrist swivel to the fork cheek.

name: Status light strip, mast
function: Faces where the wand points. It shows the arm state.

name: Light ring, wand tip
function: Lights the cabin for the camera and shows that the nozzle works.

name: Status light ring, J1 base
function: Shows the arm state: teal ready, amber moving, green cleaning, red fault.
